title: Bayesian quantum sensing using graybox machine learning
abstract: arXiv:2601.17465v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Quantum sensors offer significant advantages over classical devices in spatial resolution and sensitivity, enabling transformative applications across materials science, healthcare, and beyond. Their practical performance, however, is often constrained by unmodelled effects, including noise, imperfect state preparation, and non-ideal control fields. In this work, we report the first experimental implementation of a graybox modelling strategy for a solid-state open quantum system. The graybox framework integrates a physics-based system model with a data-driven description of experimental imperfections, achieving higher fidelity than purely analytical (whitebox) approaches while requiring fewer training resources than fully deep-learning blackbox models. translated_title: 基于灰箱机器学习的贝叶斯量子传感
translated_abstract: 量子传感器在空间分辨率和灵敏度方面相比经典设备具有显著优势，能够在材料科学、医疗健康等领域实现变革性应用。然而，其实际性能往往受到未建模效应的限制，包括噪声、不完美的态制备以及非理想的控制场。在这项工作中，我们首次在固态开放量子系统上实验实现了灰箱建模策略。灰箱框架将基于物理的系统模型与数据驱动的实验不完美性描述相结合，在实现比纯解析（白箱）方法更高保真度的同时，比完全依赖深度学习的黑箱模型需要更少的训练资源。我们在利用单自旋量子传感器估计静态磁场的任务上对该方法进行了实验验证，并使用灰箱模型进行贝叶斯推断。
tldr: 该工作首次在固态开放量子系统上实验实现了灰箱机器学习建模策略，将物理模型与数据驱动方法相结合，在单自旋量子传感器磁场估计任务中，实现了比白箱方法更高保真度且比黑箱模型更省训练资源的贝叶斯量子传感。
en_tdlr: This work presents the first experimental implementation of a graybox machine learning strategy for a solid-state open quantum system, combining physics-based modeling with data-driven descriptions of imperfections to achieve higher-fidelity Bayesian quantum sensing than whitebox approaches while requiring fewer training resources than blackbox models.
